retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-angle shot of a stone manor house under a dramatic, sepia-toned stormy sky, featuring prominent white blackletter display type at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle, low-perspective view of a sprawling stone manor house with multiple gables and chimneys. The building is cast in cool blue-gray tones, contrasting sharply with a turbulent, warm sepia and ochre sky. A single window is illuminated with a warm yellow glow. Large, ornate white blackletter text dominates the upper third of the frame, separated from the image by a thin horizontal line and decorative dots.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia sky vs. cool blue-gray stone architecture
Massive white display type vs. detailed architectural texture
Single warm light source vs. dark, moody environment
Horizontal division between typographic header and photographic subject
coreInvariants: Bicolor palette of sepia and blue-gray

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The manor house occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, stretching horizontally across the entire width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white blackletter text at the top acts as the primary anchor, followed by the illuminated window.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold white text, move down to the illuminated window, then scan the horizontal expanse of the manor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides textured negative space that supports the large-scale typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and dark sky; muted saturation across the landscape.

letterConstructionRules: Consistent stroke width for main stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the first and last letters to frame the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate Blackletter for the main title paired with a clean, spaced-out Serif for the subtitle.
graphicDevices: Thin border around the entire composition

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional gothic blackletter feel
Provides the necessary weight and angularity

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a large, multi-gabled stone manor house at dusk. The house should be in cool blue-gray tones with one window glowing warm yellow. The sky above should be filled with dramatic, swirling clouds in sepia and ochre tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white blackletter title at the top. Below it, add a thin horizontal line with small dots, and a centered subtitle in all-caps serif with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the main text in a bold blackletter font?
Is there a single glowing window?

mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title
Unique architectural details of the specific house
postGenerationChecks: Check for color balance between sky and house
Ensure typography doesn't obscure key architectural features
Verify the 'glow' effect on the window looks natural
Confirm the blackletter font has sufficient weight
